macros.title: Billing - Credit Card Decline Code 51
macros.body: Hello, error code 51 indicates insufficient funds or a credit limit hold. Please contact your card issuer or update your payment method in your billing portal.

macros.title: Billing - Credit Card Error Code 14 (Invalid Number)
macros.body: Hello, error code 14 signifies an invalid card number. Please re-enter your 16-digit card number and confirm postal code formatting without special characters.

macros.title: Billing - Error Code 430357 Lost/Stolen Card
macros.body: Hello, error code 430357 indicates the card has been reported lost or stolen by the issuer. Please use an alternative payment card.

macros.title: Billing - Payment Retry Schedule (5 over 5 days)
macros.body: Failed subscription renewal payments are automatically retried up to 5 times over 5 consecutive days before grace period expiry.

macros.title: Security - Google Voice 2FA Insecurity
macros.body: We strongly advise against using Google Voice for 2FA SMS verification codes due to VoIP hijacking and lockout vulnerabilities.

macros.title: Security - Titan Security Key Recovery
macros.body: If you lost your primary security key, account recovery takes 3-5 business days. Please use your secondary backup authentication step.

macros.title: Shipping - Regional Delivery Times
macros.body: Hardware shipments to North America deliver in 3-5 business days (Express: 1-2 days). EMEA delivers in 4-6 business days.

macros.title: Refund - Retired 14-Day Window [SUPERSEDED]
macros.body: Thank you for contacting customer care. Under our 14-day refund policy, refund requests must be received within 14 calendar days of transaction date. Transactions beyond 14 days cannot be refunded.

macros.title: Refund - Current 30-Day Satisfaction Policy [ACTIVE]
macros.body: Thank you for contacting customer support. Under our 30-day satisfaction guarantee (refund-and-returns-policy-30day-v2), subscription and digital license purchases within 30 days are fully refundable.

macros.title: Escalation - Non-Tier-1 Complex Dispute Transfer
macros.body: Your request has been escalated to Tier-2 Operations for manual account ledger reconciliation. A senior specialist will review your ticket within 4 business hours.
